Mel: Heads-up — planning a compact deploy block tomorrow 2026-03-19 13:00-13:30 PST. Want to fit 3 small rollouts. Who can own smoke for each? :calendar:
Jamie: I can take slot A (13:00-13:10). PRs: #4237, #4240. Smoke steps OK.
Priya: Taking slot B (13:10-13:20). PR #4219 is merging now. Will validate metrics end-to-end.
Natalie: Slot C (13:20-13:30) tentative. I'm blocked by a migration; ETA 12:45. If migration delayed, I'll backfill with a small config bump.
Chuck: I'll be overall rollback lead. If any slot fails, we roll back in order C->B->A. I'll trigger rollback runbook.
DevOps Bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-19 13:00-13:30 PST. Reminder: read the quiet-window play.
Mel: Quick checklist for smoke owners — please run these and post short pass/fail: 1) health endpoints, 2) sample gen baseline, 3) DB migrations applied, 4) latency spike check.
Priya: For slot B, note that embedding worker pool will be drained first. I added a feature flag in #4219.
Jamie: Adding smoke commands:
```
# smoke script
curl -s https://canary.redwood/api/health | jq .status
python tools/smoke_test.py --route /v1/generate --n 5
```
Mel: If any step fails, add :warning: and tag @Chuck. Chuck, confirm rollback cadence (time to rollback per slot)
Chuck: Confirmed — target <5m to rollback per slot. I'll monitor logs, and have infra helm rollback command ready.
Natalie: FYI, I'll be paired with @Priya for metrics dashboards during my slot in case we need to escalate.
Jamie: ETA: will start handoff 12:50 to warm caches.
Mel: Great. Final ask: post a one-line result after your smoke (pass/fail + key metric if fail). Thanks all. :rocket:
